caveats.text: The Belize veterinary health certificate is completed outside Petra (Phase 2); Petra records that it was accepted, not that Petra issued it.

The BAHA import permit, the 48-hour arrival notice, and the port-of-entry inspection are BAHA's own external process; Petra records that you submitted/notified, not that BAHA approved or cleared the animal.

requirements.title: 28-day wait after a first rabies dose; no dose before 12 weeks old
Veterinary health certificate (within 14 days; APHIS endorsement NOT required)

manual_checklist.title: Apply for the BAHA import permit
manual_checklist.detail: A BAHA import permit (around BZ$50, valid ~90 days, up to ~10 pets) must be obtained before travel. Your vet completes the permit form and it is sent to the Belize Agriculture Department for issuance. Without the permit BAHA can refuse entry.

manual_checklist.title: Notify BAHA at least 2 days before arrival
manual_checklist.detail: Email BAHA with the arrival date, time, and flight number so a veterinary officer is present at the port of entry. This advance notice is mandatory; without it the pet may be refused or held while BAHA arranges inspection.

manual_checklist.title: Puppies: first rabies dose not before 12 weeks (84 days) old
manual_checklist.detail: BAHA's Import Conditions document (item D): puppies must NOT be vaccinated against rabies before they are 3 months (12 weeks / 84 days) old, and the rabies certificate must include the puppy's age or date of birth. Petra's rabies_wait requirement enforces this structurally when the dose's date and the pet's date of birth are both on file.

manual_checklist.title: Adult dogs 15 months+: booster-history exemption from the 28-day wait
manual_checklist.detail: BAHA's Import Conditions document (item E): a dog 15 months or older may travel less than 4 weeks after a booster vaccination if accompanied by proof of a documented rabies-vaccination history (at least one dose given after 3 months old, plus one current booster). Without that documented history, the ordinary ≥28-day first-time wait applies. Petra's rabies_wait requirement waives the wait automatically when a qualifying prior dose is on file (evidenced continuity).

manual_checklist.title: Inspection fee on arrival
manual_checklist.detail: BAHA collects an inspection fee in cash at the port of entry. The amount changes — confirm the current fee with BAHA before travel and bring local cash.

manual_checklist.title: Endoparasite treatment within 30 days
manual_checklist.detail: Proof of internal (and external) anti-parasitic treatment within 30 days of travel should accompany the health certificate and vaccination records.

manual_checklist.title: First rabies dose ≥28 days before travel
manual_checklist.detail: If this is the pet's first rabies vaccination, it must be given at least 28 days before travel — Petra's rabies_wait requirement enforces this structurally (waived automatically for a documented booster with evidenced continuity).

manual_checklist.title: If your pet is under 4 months old: expect home quarantine
manual_checklist.detail: Pets less than 4 months can be brought in but are held in home quarantine until rabies can be administered, plus 30 days after.

sources.authority: Belize Agricultural Health Authority (BAHA), Animal Health Department
sources.applies_to: US-origin dog/cat import to Belize — the species-specific destination-authority document
supporting_requirements: "a veterinary certificate issued within two (2) weeks of travel date" (item 1 — confirms the 14-day certificate window)

"vaccinated against Rabies and that its vaccination is current" (item B); "first time must be vaccinated at least 4 weeks (28 days) before traveling" (item C); "Puppies must NOT be vaccinated against rabies before they are 3-months (12 weeks or 84 days) old" (item D, NEW); "Adult dogs (15 months or older) may travel less than 4 weeks after a booster vaccination if... proof of a history of previous rabies vaccination" (item E, NEW)

"All dogs must be vaccinated against Distemper, Hepatitis, Leptospirosis and Parvovirus. All cats must be vaccinated against Feline Viral Rhinotracheitis, Calici Virus and Panleukopenia." (item F — RE-PROMOTES these seven vaccines from recommended to gating, correcting the 2026-06-23 demotion)
"treated against endoparasites with a registered product in the country of origin within thirty (30) days of exportation" (item G)
